steps.narration: First I take a medium box, that's enough for up to five items, and put the order sheet on top.
Then I pick the items. Always check the litre size, the 0.5 and 1 litre cartons look the same.
Heavy stuff goes to the bottom, crispbread on top, and paper in the gaps so nothing moves.
Tape it shut and the label goes on top, never over the tape.
